user.title: Petoneer Smart Dot
user.description: Configure the MQTT topics used by the Petoneer Smart Dot Deno bridge. The bridge must be running separately (see README).

data_description.command_topic: MQTT topic the Deno bridge listens on for incoming commands (default: petoneer_smartdot/command).
data_description.state_topic: MQTT topic the Deno bridge publishes the current state to (default: petoneer_smartdot/state).
